name: Nose (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nose town emblem in white: an outlined fan-shaped device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Nose, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1960.

features.role: Nose town emblem — an outlined fan-shaped device enclosing a stylised character
